notes.title: Drill Keeper Digs Into the "Games Baked in Germany" Event!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Dirt Dwellers![/h1]

Exciting news from the depths of development! Drill Keeper is part of the "Games Baked in Germany" event on Steam, running from June 20 to June 27. 

The "Games Baked in Germany" event kicks off on June 20 at 19:00 CEST with a special showcase on Steam and IGN's YouTube channel. It’s a celebration of the best games developed in Germany, and  I'm thrilled to be part of this lineup.

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/games-made-in-germany-2024

[h2]Check Out Drill Keeper's Reveal Trailer![/h2]
If you haven't seen Drill Keeper's reveal trailer, come see what’s been cooking in the mines.

[previewyoutube=0kL1lFkWvkY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Wishlist Now![/h2]
Don't miss your chance to dig deep and strike gold with Drill Keeper! Add us to your Steam wishlist to stay updated and support our journey. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2409320/Drill_Keeper/

Drill safe,
Denno / ShoulderByte
